# braze.com/company — "How it started"

Captured 2026-09-02 from `https://www.braze.com/company`. **Grade: `claimed`** — this is
a marketing page, and it is used here only for things a company is unlikely to get wrong
about itself and unlikely to be filed anywhere: who founded it, and the photograph.

## The founding, in Braze's own words

> "Forged from a unique series of events, Braze CEO Bill Magnuson and CTO Jon Hyman
> participated in a 2011 hackathon that led to a chance meeting with their third
> cofounder, Mark Ghermezian. They founded Braze (formerly Appboy) with the deeply held
> belief that the broad adoption of mobile would drive tremendous change in business and
> society—and it has."

Three cofounders named: **Bill Magnuson, Jon Hyman, Mark Ghermezian.** This is the only
place in any captured source where a third cofounder is named at all — the DEF 14A and
the 10-K name no founders as founders, and the word "Ghermezian" appears in neither.

The same page continues: *"Braze became a publicly traded company in November 2021
(Nasdaq: BRZE). In 2023, the company passed $500M in CARR…"*

## The photograph

`sources/media/founders-2011-techcrunch-disrupt.png`, published on this page under the
"How it started" heading, `alt="CEO and CTO"`, 1102×828. Two people at what the backdrop
identifies as TechCrunch Disrupt NYC 2011.

**The page does not say which figure is which**, and neither does the alt text. The deck
captions the pair and never left-to-right.

## Why the cofounder names matter to this analysis

Braze retired its dual-class stock on 2026-01-30, and the 10-K's own wording is that
"our executive officers and early investors no longer hold super-voting rights". The
natural follow-up is whether the founders are still in place. Two of the three are:
Magnuson and Hyman both hold executive office and both have done so since July 2011,
which the DEF 14A establishes independently and under legal penalty. The third,
Ghermezian, appears in no filing.

The largest disclosed holder of Class A stock is a private Canadian investment company,
MCG7 Capital Inc., holding 6.0% partly through an entity named **"Appboy BH LLC"** —
Appboy being Braze's original name. **The proxy does not connect MCG7 to any named
individual, and neither does this analysis.** The observation is recorded and stops there.
